resources.string: Yana gano abin da aka faɗa a cikin saƙonnin murya da bidiyoyi na %1$s, waɗanda binciken maganar Turanci ba zai iya karantawa ba. A gwajinmu saƙon murya daidai ya fito farko %2$d%% na lokaci, sabanin %3$d%% ba tare da shi ba.

Yana sake karanta maganar da ba ta Turanci ba, don haka waɗannan fayilolin suna ɗaukar lokaci mai tsawo, kuma ba cikakke ba ne: yi tsammanin wasu kalmomi marasa daidai. Ana karanta Turanci kamar da. Harshen magana ɗaya a lokaci guda; yana buƙatar ƙarin ƙwaƙwalwa lokacin aiki kawai.
